races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict: BAJAN BANDIT 's recent victories have come at a lower level than this, yet he was a ready winner on the latest of them at Wolverhampton 9 days ago and, escaping a penalty, he may well take some stepping from a good draw in this form. Havana Touch has done well on all-weather this year and he commands plenty of respect too, with Nakaaha and The Hare Rail completing the shortlist. BAJAN BANDIT HAVANA TOUCH NAKAAHA
